scope: Read-only review while the author freezes the candidate; no production hookup or performance acceptance is implied
confirmed_contract: Compact a/b/c is an opt-in output representation, not incremental or early-release text
The host continues reading to done; closed braces/first-content metrics never authorize speech
Explicit output-format requests with done_reason=length fail as backend_output_truncated even if the JSON object has already closed; EOF before done is rejected

The board fully parses one bounded compact object, rejects duplicate/extra/authority fields, malformed types, thinking/control text, bad emotion/action, trailing content and incomplete prefixes, then restores canonical reply_text/emotion/avatar_action
The exact original owner is validated before decode; one request retains original budget/deadline/cancellation and no fallback model retry is introduced
Only the exact selected static system prompt's output field identifiers can change; later messages and caller-owned reference/user text are preserved
Summary, thinking, TTS, GPU ownership, foreground preemption, model choice, num_ctx=2048 and the ordinary 120-token default remain unchanged
Canonical restored output still enters the original BoardDialogueController validator and source tracking; no model-supplied provenance or profile grant is accepted
Store generated/dependency checks, fresh playback guards and complete actual ACK remain owned by the unchanged controller/Store chain
New observation metrics are finite numbers/counts only; raw content/thinking text is not retained by the observer

conditional_release_issue.issue: This separate whole-file variant is derived from old 9af4a5bf policy and lacks the current v13 memory-health generation/diagnostic fix
conditional_release_issue.required_action_if_used: Exclude the optional whole file from the core publication, or apply only the single prompt-order hunk to fresh 48c7499f/current policy and re-pin it. Never overwrite the current policy with this old-base file.

boundaries: Truncation finish-code enforcement is enabled for explicit output_format requests; unchanged legacy/default and summary requests are not claimed to gain that new enforcement
Unknown or absent done_reason currently retains original completion behavior when done=true; any stricter termination policy should be explicit and tested
first_json_closed_ms is a bracket-closure timing observation, not evidence of valid JSON, current authority or completed playback
The adapter must be injected only after capability negotiation, and both host/board wire plus the new shared helper must be pinned together
The optional context-order experiment must remain a separate measured variable; cache-hit counts are never a source authorization or forgotten-text reuse grant
additional_integration_tests_recommended: Expire the original deadline after complete JSON arrives but before controller adoption; prove no generated assistant, TTS, network completion or heard ACK
Exercise explicit json/canonical-schema/compact modes with length finish, closed JSON then EOF before done, cancellation after closure, and missing/unknown finish reasons under the chosen policy
Use the fresh v13 real synthetic Store and scoped read checker with the compact adapter: normal answer keeps exact source refs, complete PCM receipt and actual ACK
During that synthetic path forget/correct/clear/revoke through another authorized Store instance after first output packet; prove later packets/ACK are rejected
Verify startup capability absence/mismatch rejects activation or follows the original path without compact decode; no adapter may assume an unadvertised host capability
Before any optional prefix test, verify current memory-worker restart-generation regression still passes on the rebased policy
